results.sql: WITH paired AS (SELECT t.name AS tract_name,COALESCE(n.n,0) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE),0) AS code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,COALESCE(n.n,0) AS code_violations_count,CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,CAST(h.bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS bphigh_prevalence,t.geoid FROM fw_pg.tracts t LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts n ON n.geoid=t.geoid AND n.run_id='r_20261026_647dd1' AND n.source='m1_city' AND n.grp='all' LEFT JOIN session.probe_647dd1_1 h ON h.tractfips=t.geoid WHERE CAST(h.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE)>0 AND h.bphigh_crudeprev IS NOT NULL) SELECT tract_name,code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,code_violations_count,totalpopulation,bphigh_prevalence,CORR(code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,bphigh_prevalence) OVER () AS rate_prevalence_correlation,COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,geoid FROM paired ORDER BY code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST,tract_name
